name: iban_validation
title: IBAN Validation and Formatting
summary: A capability to validate, normalize, and format International Bank Account Numbers (IBAN) and calculate missing check digits.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validates an IBAN string. It checks the checksum and the country-specific structure. If the IBAN is invalid, it returns false.

params.name: iban_string
params.description: The IBAN to validate (can include spaces or separators).

returns.name: is_valid
returns.description: Whether the IBAN is valid according to checksum and country rules.

returns.name: formatted_iban
returns.description: The IBAN formatted with spaces every 4 characters for readability.

tools.implementation_notes: To implement 'validate_iban', first call 'stdnum.iban.compact(iban_string)' to get the compact version. Then, use 'stdnum.iban.is_valid(iban_string)' to check validity. If valid, return the compact version and the formatted version using 'stdnum.iban.format(compact_iban)'. If invalid, return is_valid=False and the compact version (if possible) or the original string.

tools.name: calculate_iban_check_digits
tools.description: Calculates the two-digit check digits required to make an IBAN valid. Use this when you have an IBAN with 'xx' in the check digit position.

params.name: iban_with_placeholders
params.description: The IBAN with placeholders (e.g., 'xx') in the check digit position.

returns.name: check_digits
returns.description: The two-digit check digits that should be inserted into the IBAN.

returns.name: formatted_iban_with_digits
returns.description: The complete, valid IBAN with the calculated digits inserted.

tools.implementation_notes: Call 'stdnum.iban.calc_check_digits(iban_with_placeholders)' to get the check digits. Then, use string replacement to insert these digits into the 'xx' position of the compact version of the IBAN. Finally, return the formatted version using 'stdnum.iban.format()'.

uncertainties: The 'validate' method might raise 'ValidationError' or 'InvalidComponent' or 'InvalidFormat' if the IBAN is invalid, which the 'is_valid' wrapper handles by returning False.
